# TableRow

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Contains the cells and styling for one table row.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`. Implements `IElement`, `IBackgroundColor`, `IRoleProvider`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new TableRow(cells?: TableCell[])
new TableRow(options: TableRowOptions)
```

## Properties

- [`backgroundColor`](#backgroundcolor): Row fill.
- [`cells`](#cells): The cells in this row
- [`color`](#color): Row text colour.
- [`isFooter`](#isfooter): Whether this is a footer row
- [`isHeader`](#isheader): Whether this is a header row
- [`minHeight`](#minheight): Minimum height for this row (optional) Accepts a length: a number of points, `'1cm'`, or `{ value, unit }`.
- [`padding`](#padding): Row padding.
- [`runningValue`](#runningvalue): The amount this body row adds to the table's running total, when the table has a `runningTotalColumn`.
- [`semanticRole`](#semanticrole): The PDF structure role this element claims (e.g. `SemanticRole.H1`, `SemanticRole.P`, `SemanticRole.Figure`).

### `backgroundColor`

```typescript
backgroundColor: Color | undefined
```

Row fill. Accepts a palette token or hex.

Example, from `industry-templates/healthcare/patient-summary`:

```typescript
if (outside) row.backgroundColor = ColorPalette.rose[50];
```

Minimum height for this row (optional)

Accepts a length: a number of points, `'1cm'`, or `{ value, unit }`.

### `padding`

```typescript
padding: Thickness | undefined
```

Row padding. Undefined falls back to the table's `cellPadding`.

### `runningValue`

```typescript
runningValue?: number | undefined
```

*optional*

The amount this body row adds to the table's running total, when the table has a `runningTotalColumn`. Rows without one add nothing.

### `semanticRole`

```typescript
readonly semanticRole: SemanticRole
```

*read-only*

The PDF structure role this element claims (e.g. [`SemanticRole.H1`](semantic-role.md#h1), [`SemanticRole.P`](semantic-role.md#p), [`SemanticRole.Figure`](semantic-role.md#figure)).
